metadata.methods_description: Participants (n=41; 20 from Jaeger et al. 2020, 21 from Holtze et al. 2021) performed a two-competing speaker paradigm with selective attention instructions (attend left or right audiobook). Experimental blocks consisted of 10-minute audiobook presentations. Jaeger et al. (2020) presented both audiobooks at equal loudness across six blocks. Holtze et al. (2021) alternated between omnidirectional (equal loudness) and beamforming (attended book louder) conditions across five blocks, with the first block always omnidirectional. EOG channels were recorded throughout all sessions.

citation_details.title: Eye-Blink Patterns Reflect Attention to Continuous Speech
